answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 31912 Country: India Title: Plz tell me do we have to recite quran behind imam.espcially in Zuhr and Asr when Imam Sahib is reciting Quitely. Question: Plz tell me do we have to recite quran behind imam.espcially in Zuhr and Asr when Imam Sahib is reciting Quitely.Plz guide me. Answer ID: 31912 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 724/601/B=1432) It is mentioned in a hadith: انما جعل الإمام ليوتم به فإذا كبر فكبروا واذا قرأ فأنصتوا . “The Imam is to be followed, so when he says 'Allahu Akbar', say 'Allahu Akbar', and when he recites the holy Quran observe the silence.” Another hadith says: قراءة الإمام قراءة له . “The recitation of Imam is enough for muqtadi.” According to Hanafi Fiqh, in view of these hadith muqtadi will not recite Quran behind imam, whether it is Zuhr and Asr or Maghrib and Isha salah. Muqtadi shall remain silent behind his Imam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
